feedback_rules.description: Visible errors include lack of synchronization and missed drum cues; expressive variations allowed in gestures

learning_units.description: Control lion head movements including eyes, mouth, and ears
Coordinate footwork between head and tail dancers
Synchronize movements with drum and cymbal rhythms

prerequisites.description: Physical coordination and stamina for acrobatic movements

social_formats.description: Performed by pairs (head and tail dancers) in open formations with shared rhythm

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Head dancer manipulates lion head features; tail dancer controls tail movements
movement_profile.footwork: Coordinated stepping, lifting, and balancing; acrobatic stunts in advanced performances
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two dancers per lion, performing in open spaces or on platforms
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Flexible and expressive to simulate lion's body language
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes crouching, leaping, and balancing on raised platforms
movement_profile.partnering: Close coordination between head and tail dancers essential
movement_profile.posture: Dynamic, with dancers crouching and leaping to mimic lion movements

signature_moves.description: Head dancer blinks lion's eyes to express emotion
signature_moves.name: Lion's blink

signature_moves.description: Mouth opens and closes to simulate roaring
signature_moves.name: Lion's roar

signature_moves.description: Dancers perform jumps and balancing acts on platforms
signature_moves.name: Acrobatic leap

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Rhythmic and lively, matching percussion tempo
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Disrespecting the ritual significance Improper handling of the lion head Unsafe acrobatic stunts without training

music_profile.musical_form: call-and-response patterns between drums and cymbals
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Percussion patterns correspond to lion movements, including drum rolls and cymbal crashes
music_profile.sound_description: The music features a vigorous drumbeat with sharp cymbal crashes and resonant gong strikes, creating a lively and auspicious atmosphere that guides the lion's movements.

basic_steps: One dancer controls the lion head, coordinating eye, mouth, and ear movements
Second dancer controls the tail, maintaining rhythm and balance
Perform basic lion steps: stepping forward, backward, side to side with synchronized footwork
Practice lifting and lowering the lion to mimic natural movements
Coordinate with drum beats for timing and expression
teaching.formation: Performed by two dancers in a single lion costume, usually on open flat ground or raised platforms
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on basic coordination and timing; advanced performers incorporate acrobatics and expressive gestures
teaching.rhythm: Driven by vigorous drumbeats, gongs, and cymbals with specific patterns matching lion movements
